scope: Seven contextual links added in five existing guides. No article rewrite, new URL, metadata change, publication/modified date change, image replacement, or layout change.
auditMethod: Parse the 183 canonical sitemap pages' static HTML with BeautifulSoup. Follow internal a[href] destinations that are also in the sitemap, remove self-links, and calculate shortest link distance from the homepage. For body-link counts, require a main ancestor and exclude nav, footer, the library indexes and .related boilerplate. These are static navigation observations, not Google's actual crawl path, ranking weights, or an assessment of every link's editorial quality.

verification.proofread: PASS for the seven added navigation paragraphs. Destination titles, TLDRs and relevant sections were read to verify the description and reader next step. Safety limits remain visible. No hardware behavior was tested.
verification.preservation: Compared each source page with baselineRef using BeautifulSoup. Its complete head is unchanged. Removing only the approved added paragraphs leaves the same parsed page apart from whitespace-only nodes, preserving original body copy, headings, dates, styles, scripts, image markup and schema.
verification.browser: Chromium at 1440x900, 390x900, 360x900, plus 390x900 with JavaScript disabled. All 28 link journeys reach the expected H1 and canonical and return to the source with browser Back. Tara Avenir and regular heading weight are retained; links fit without horizontal document overflow. Mobile screenshots of every added paragraph were inspected. No page errors or real form submissions; analytics requests blocked.
verification.staticGates: Site-wide typography, blog layout, editorial copy, cover quality and protected SEO-intent checks passed. No new article, changed metadata, new image or code sample is introduced, so this does not certify the entire legacy articles as newly written or newly researched.
verification.articleMetadataCheck: Four source articles pass the candidate checker with the explicit preserved-title baseline. The notification-delivery guide fails that checker solely because its existing description is 168 characters versus the local 160-character editorial target. Its complete head is identical to baselineRef. This is recorded as a pre-existing editorial issue, not hidden as a passing check or used to trigger unrelated metadata churn. The checker and daily new-article requirements are unchanged. Google does not prescribe a fixed meta-description character limit: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/snippet

limitations: All target pages were already linked from the library and reachable. This is not a fix for wholly orphaned pages or a proven crawl-depth defect.
No new Search Console export or URL Inspection was performed. The September 15 index observations remain historical evidence for the URLs actually inspected.
The change does not prove indexing, ranking recovery, a Google link score, or additional customers.
Only the new navigation copy and destination relevance were reviewed in this pass. This is not a fresh factual certification of every claim in the five source articles.
